Get all instances instances = [] region_map = { 'module.primary': 'us-east-1', 'module.west1': 'us-west-1', 'module.west2': 'us-west-2' } for module in state['values']['root_module'].get('child_modules', []): module_addr = module['address'] region = None for prefix, r in region_map.items(): if module_addr.startswith(prefix): region = r break for resource in module.get('resources', []): if resource['type'] == 'aws_instance': instance_name = resource['address'] instance_id = resource['values']['id'] subnet_id = resource['values']['subnet_id'] # Build a mapping of subnets to VPCs subnet_vpc_map = {} for module in state['values']['root_module'].get('child_modules', []): for resource in module.get('resources', []): # Data source subnets (default VPC) if resource['type'] == 'aws_subnets' and 'data' in resource['address']: # These are in the default VPC for subnet_id in resource['values'].get('ids', []): subnet_vpc_map[subnet_id] = 'vpc-default' # Managed subnets (custom VPCs) elif resource['type'] == 'aws_subnet': subnet_id = resource['values']['id'] vpc_id = resource['values']['vpc_id'] subnet_vpc_map[subnet_id] = vpc_id # Determine which instances are NOT in default VPC not_in_default = {} in_default = {} for instance_id, data in instances_data.items(): subnet_id = data['subnet_id'] vpc_id = subnet_vpc_map.get(subnet_id, 'unknown') data['vpc_id'] = vpc_id if vpc_id != 'vpc-default': not_in_default[instance_id] = data else: in_default[instance_id] = data # Print report print("=" * 120) print("EC2 INSTANCES WITHOUT A DEFAULT VPC (ALL REGIONS)") print("=" * 120) print() if not not_in_default: print("All instances are in the default VPC.") else: print(f"Found {len(not_in_default)} instances NOT in the default VPC:\n") print(f"{'Region':<15} {'Instance ID':<20} {'Resource Address':<80}") print("-" * 115) for instance_id in sorted(not_in_default.keys()): data = not_in_default[instance_id] addr = data['name'].replace('module.', '') print(f"{data['region']:<15} {instance_id:<20} {addr:<80}") print() print(f"Summary:") print(f" - Total instances NOT in default VPC: {len(not_in_default)}") print(f" - Total instances in default VPC: {len(in_default)}") print(f" - Total instances: {len(instances_data)}") EOF python3 /tmp/final_report.py
